EXT.evidence: Asks others for money to keep playing, calls another player’s bet, and directly asks what hand they have—open, assertive table talk.

AGR.evidence: Thanks the people who contributed money and straightforwardly concedes, saying the opponent has him beat, without blaming or boasting.

CON.evidence: No clear signs of organization or carelessness beyond normal poker play; borrowing to continue the hand doesn’t clearly indicate either side.

NEU.evidence: Remains calm and accepting after losing (“when you don’t have the cards, you don’t have the cards”) and notes the opponent looks happy, showing composure rather than anxiety.

OPN.evidence: Makes routine, conventional remarks about the hand; no clear curiosity, creativity, or dogmatism shown.
